items.title: Show HN: Socks Proxy for AI Agents
items.contentSnippet:
I've built a socks5 proxy especially for AI agents, currently there are exit points in east and west US, central EU and east Asia. The payment for the service is settled by the X402 protocol, with USDC on circle/base. You can also purchase access via crypto on the webpage for humans, but the key focus is for autonomous agents.

Our time and attention won’t grow at the same rate, so software should help us make sense of more information while learning what matters to us from what we save, highlight, and share, and the questions we ask.

items.title: Show HN: Cadenya – An Agent Runtime
items.contentSnippet:
My name is Robert, and I'm the founder of Cadenya, an agent runtime.
Cadenya is not like other managed solutions. Instead, it uses your API or MCP servers as the tools in your agentic loop, which also is managed.
Cadenya is also agnostic to the model provider. Wire up OpenRouter, or any OpenAI compatible endpoint, and it will use it for inference.
It also supports agent variations - where Cadenya will select the agent's with the best feedback using Thompson Sampling.
